name: @worko/desktop

scripts.dist:linux: pnpm run dist:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.0.12 --linux AppImage --publish never
scripts.dist:linux:dir: pnpm run dist:prepare && WORKO_UPDATE_URL=${WORKO_UPDATE_URL:-https://updates.invalid/desktop} pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.0.12 --linux --dir --publish never -c.electronDist=node_modules/electron/dist
scripts.dist:win: pnpm run dist:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.0.12 --win nsis --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: pnpm run dist:prepare && pnpm dlx electron-builder@26.0.12 --mac dmg --publish never

description: Worko desktop (Electron) — offline-capable office app with tray reminders
author: Worko
